Definition: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
BiblicalUsage: 1) man; 1a) man, male (in contrast to woman, female); 1b) husband; 1c) human being, person (in contrast to God); 1d) servant; 1e) mankind; 1f) champion; 1g) great man; 2) whosoever; 3) each (adjective)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
